sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000127-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Evergreen Health Network 127 on July 13, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 4.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 3,140 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
